title: Swarm Connection Reuse - Immediate Fixes
description: Critical fixes for incoming relay connection reuse: 1) Initialize _connectionLastActivity for incoming connections in _handleIncomingConnections 2) Add 60-second grace period for new connections in _isConnectionHealthy 3) Replace test stream probing with UDX PING in _probeRelayedConnection 4) Add consecutive failure tracking instead of immediate permanent failure. See doc/connectivity-improvements-brainstorm.md for details.

title: UDX Connection Migration
description: UPDATE: Connection Migration with PATH_CHALLENGE/PATH_RESPONSE already exists in dart-udx! The work is to expose path migration events from UDX to dart-libp2p's Swarm layer so connection tracking can be updated when paths migrate. dart-udx also has CID rotation (NEW_CONNECTION_ID/RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames).

title: UDX Connection-Level Keepalives
description: UPDATE: PingFrame already exists in dart-udx! The work is to expose UDX's native PING through dart-libp2p's transport layer and replace the intrusive stream-based health probing in Swarm with calls to UDX PING. This is a quick win for connectivity reliability.

title: Relay v2 data limit and concurrent streams interop tests
description: Add interop tests for: large transfers over relay (v2 has data/time limits), multiple concurrent Yamux streams, and connection re-establishment after disconnect.

title: AutoNAT v2 interop testing
description: Test AutoNAT v2 reachability probes between Go and Dart. Can be tested on localhost but less meaningful without real NAT. Go sends probes, Dart responds.

title: Bidirectional Connection Awareness
description: Track last successful I/O per peer in both directions. Prefer connections with recent activity. Don't dial new connection if inbound path is working.

title: Coordinated protobuf 6 / pointycastle 4 upgrade across dart_libp2p, kad_dht, pubsub
description: Remainder of upstream PR #8 (by bffzo). Bump protobuf ^6, pointycastle ^4, protoc_plugin ^25, lints ^6 in dart_libp2p together with dart_libp2p_kad_dht and dart_libp2p_pubsub (both pin protobuf ^3.1.0; kad_dht pins pointycastle ^3.7.0), regenerate all .pb.dart, raise SDK floor to ^3.7.0, and drop the deprecated lib/pb/noise re-export shims. Credit bffzo as commit author for the dart_libp2p part.
notes:
Origin: upstream PR #8 'Dependencies major upgrade' by bffzo <bffzo@proton.me> (https://github.com/stephanfeb/dart_libp2p/pull/8). The non-breaking half (Noise payload proto colocation + envelope/AutoNAT proto fixes) landed as b088993, authored by bffzo.

Why deferred: dart pub get fails if only dart_libp2p bumps protobuf, because dart_libp2p_kad_dht and dart_libp2p_pubsub (dev deps here, and their published 1.3.0) pin protobuf ^3.1.0; kad_dht also pins pointycastle ^3.7.0. protobuf 6.x and protoc_plugin 25.x require Dart SDK ^3.7.0.

Steps:
1. Bump in dart_libp2p: protobuf ^6.0.0, pointycastle ^4.0.0, protoc_plugin ^25.0.0, lints ^6.0.0, sdk ^3.7.0.
2. Same protobuf/pointycastle/protoc_plugin bumps in ../dart-libp2p-kad-dht and ../dart-libp2p-pubsub; regenerate their .pb.dart.
3. Regenerate every .pb.dart in dart_libp2p from its colocated .proto (do not hand-merge PR #8's generated files; they are stale vs circuitv2 changes).
4. Check pointycastle 4 API changes compile (kad_dht and dart_libp2p crypto).
5. Remove deprecated re-export shims lib/pb/noise/* and lib/pb/proto/noise/* (breaking: note in CHANGELOG).
6. lints ^6 will surface new analyzer infos; triage separately if noisy.
7. Release all three packages together (major bump for dart_libp2p due to SDK floor + shim removal).

Credit: commit the dart_libp2p part with --author='bffzo <bffzo@proton.me>'.
Related: dart-libp2p-t8o (DHT protobuf wire format) touches kad_dht protobuf code; coordinate ordering.

title: Connectivity Improvements - Connection Reuse & Reliability
description: Investigate and fix connection reuse issues: 1) Incoming relay connections not reused for outbound, 2) Aggressive health checking marking working connections as failed, 3) Activity tracking gap for new connections. See doc/connectivity-improvements-brainstorm.md

title: Signed peer record envelope round-trip verification
description: Verify signed peer record envelopes round-trip correctly between Dart and Go during identify exchange. Check envelope signature validation and address certification.

title: Relay Connection Race Condition - Connection Not Found During Upgrade
description: When incoming relay connection arrives, upgradeInbound takes time (Noise+Yamux negotiation). During upgrade, if app tries to dial back, connectedness() returns notConnected because SwarmConn not yet created. System then tries direct dial which times out. Fix: 1) Mark peer as connected (with placeholder) during upgrade 2) Prefer relay addresses for peers that connected via relay

title: ECDSA public keys marshal as SEQUENCE{x,y} instead of PKIX
description: EcdsaPublicKey.raw (lib/core/crypto/ecdsa.dart) encodes a bare ASN.1 SEQUENCE of the point's x and y, and fromRawBytes parses that form. The libp2p spec and go-libp2p use DER PKIX (x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey), so Go ECDSA keys fail to unmarshal (now reachable through Noise since Darren Warner's commit from PR #10) and our ECDSA peer IDs do not match Go's. Fix like RSA in fd02f2b: marshal PKIX, accept both on unmarshal, add go-libp2p vectors (see test/crypto/rsa_go_interop_test.dart). ECDSA private keys: Go uses x509.MarshalECPrivateKey (SEC1).

title: STUN Integration for NAT Type Detection
description: Integrate STUN to detect NAT type (full cone, restricted, symmetric). Skip futile direct dial attempts for symmetric NAT. Guide address ranking.

title: Circuit Relay Address Format Fix - Missing Relay Peer ID
description: CRITICAL: Incoming relay connections were storing addresses without the relay's peer ID (e.g., /ip4/.../udx/p2p-circuit/p2p/DEST instead of /ip4/.../udx/p2p/RELAY_ID/p2p-circuit/p2p/DEST). This caused canDial() to reject the addresses when trying to dial back to peers that connected via relay, resulting in 'No transport found for address' errors. Fixed by including relay peer ID in circuit address construction in _handleStreamV2.

title: DHT: Switch wire format from JSON to protobuf for Go interop
description:
dart-libp2p-kad-dht has two wire format issues blocking Go interop:

1. **JSON encoding instead of protobuf**: The IpfsDHT uses jsonEncode/jsonDecode for DHT messages (dht.dart lines ~350, ~370, ~1550, ~1585), but the spec requires protobuf. The protobuf types already exist in lib/src/pb/dht.pb.dart.

2. **Missing varint-length framing**: Go DHT uses go-msgio (varint length prefix + protobuf bytes). The Dart DHT does raw stream.read()/stream.write() without length-prefix framing.

Both must be fixed: switch to Message.writeToBuffer()/mergeFromBuffer() and add varint-length framing around each message.

Blocking: DHT interop tests in dart-libp2p (test/interop/go_dht_interop_test.dart) are skipped.

title: Hole Punching (DCUtR) interop testing
description: Test DCUtR (/libp2p/dcutr) protocol between Dart and Go. Requires simulated NAT or multi-machine setup. Relay interop is done (prerequisite). Needs: NAT simulation, coordination protocol impl verification.
